big_case.notes: The order determined whether Dennes could obtain federal review of his sentencing claim before his scheduled execution. The Texas successive-writ rule has consequences for other prisoners, but the Court issued no ruling on that rule or on counsel’s mitigation investigation.

leakage.notes: The forward log captured all seven call results. The corpus searches concerned recent denials and linked petition 26-6187. The combined lookup carries a November 17 document date, and the candidate reports that the linked petition showed no disposition. Its rationale expressly describes the November 19 decision as unknown. Nothing in the log or prose shows prior access to the denial.
